topic: Spring Boot and REST API Development
learningObjectives: Explain the structure of a Spring Boot REST application.
Design REST endpoints using controllers and HTTP methods.
Construct a basic request-to-response flow for a Spring Boot API.

activities.title: Spring Boot Architecture
activities.instruction: Explore the layers of a REST application.

content.concept: A typical Spring Boot REST application separates request handling, business logic, data access, and persistence responsibilities.

activities.title: REST Endpoint Anatomy
activities.instruction: Explore the parts of a REST endpoint.

content.concept: A REST endpoint combines a URL path, HTTP method, request data, controller logic, and response.

activities.title: REST Method Selector
activities.instruction: Choose the HTTP method for each operation.

content.concept: REST APIs commonly use GET for retrieval, POST for creation, PUT or PATCH for updates, and DELETE for removal.
